subject: AirNexus Retreat — surge cover, flight consolidation & VIP transit
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@airnexus.com>, Tyler Nguyen <tyler.nguyen@airnexus.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AirNexus Retreat — surge cover, flight consolidation & VIP transit

Hi Samantha / Tyler,

Quick note from the Redwood field team: we’re finalizing travel and on-site coverage for the AirNexus Retreat (July 14–16) and want to compress a few things to reduce transit costs and simplify badge pickup. Attached is an initial roster and preferred arrival windows (initial_roster_v1.xlsx).

As asks:
- Can AirNexus confirm the single-point arrival window (7/13 afternoon vs. evening) for crew drop-off and whether there’s a designated loading dock for AV gear?
- We have one VIP (Ryan Patel, CPO) arriving on 7/13 AM — can we get a separate lobby escort and expedited badge lane?
- Any constraints on consolidating flights into the 3:30–7:00 PM block on 7/13? That would let us book a shuttle and avoid split hotel blocks.

Internal: Lauren — I’ve flagged three roles we’ll need surge coverage for (onsite demo, back-of-house AV, VIP support). Please review and propose pairings. Marissa — can you check hotel block availability for the consolidated arrival? Ethan/Dylan — hold the 7/13 evening shuttle as tentative.

Thanks — Priyom

Attachment: initial_roster_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 92KB)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@airnexus.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tyler Nguyen <tyler.nguyen@airnexus.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AirNexus Retreat — surge cover, flight consolidation & VIP transit

Hi Priyom — thanks for the roster. Short answers:
- Loading dock is Dock B, door opens at 2pm on 7/13 for exhibitor load-in; AV trucks can stage there.
- We can provide a lobby escort for Ryan Patel and a fast-track badge lane (please send his flight and ETA once booked).
- Consolidation into 3:30–7:00 PM on 7/13 is preferred — it helps with shuttle staging. If anyone must arrive earlier we’ll have a secure holding area but badge pickup will be limited until 4pm.

One ask from our side: we need a smallest-possible consolidated manifest for airport pick-ups (names + flight numbers + mobile). Can you supply by EOD 6/18?

— Samantha

Attachment: none

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@airnexus.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AirNexus Retreat — surge cover, flight consolidation & VIP transit

Priyom — nailed down pairings and a hotel block suggestion. I shifted two floaters to cover demo + VIP support so we won’t need extra headcount on-site. See rooming_list.csv attached for who we proposed to put into the Riverfront Hotel (5 min from venue).

Notes for internal ops:
- Pairing: Marissa (lead demo) + Ethan (AV floater) on primary shift 9:00–3:30; Dylan assigned 3:00–close as floater/relief.
- VIP: Marissa to be backup for VIP escort if Ryan’s arrival slips; Samantha will own the lobby escort primary.
- Travel consolidation: I recommend booking the 4:45 PM redeye-alternative block for anyone with late connections — keeps travel windows aligned and reduces shuttle runs.

Samantha — if Riverfront is acceptable we’ll push the contract hold today.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachment: rooming_list.csv (csv, 8KB)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@airnexus.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AirNexus Retreat — surge cover, flight consolidation & VIP transit

On Fri, Jun 25, 2027 at 02:10 PM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Can AirNexus confirm the single-point arrival window (7/13 afternoon vs. evening) for crew drop-off and whether there’s a designated loading dock for AV gear?

All good from my side — I’ll hold on the shuttle booking until we have the final flight manifest. I can be on standby at the airport from 3:30–8:30 PM on 7/13 to handle any split arrivals. If things shift, ping me and I’ll reroute.

— Dylan

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@airnexus.com>, Tyler Nguyen <tyler.nguyen@airnexus.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final — AirNexus Retreat consolidated schedule, manifest, and next steps

Folks — closing this thread with the final consolidated schedule attached (consolidated_schedule.pdf) and the flight manifest (flight_manifest.xlsx). Key points:
- All crew consolidated into 3:30–6:45 PM arrival window on 7/13 except Ryan Patel (VIP) arriving 7/13 09:15 AM — Samantha will meet him and escort to a holding suite.
- Hotel block confirmed at Riverfront Hotel (block reference: RF-4832). Marissa, rooming is aligned with the CSV you sent; thanks.
- Shuttle: booked for 7/13 16:30 / 18:15 / 19:30 (three runs). Dylan will be primary airport lead.
- AV load-in: Dock B open 14:00–18:00; Ethan will coordinate the handoff with Tyler on-site.
- Action items:
  * Marissa — finalize on-site kit list and courier label by 7/5.
  * Lauren — send final staffing schedule to Samantha by 7/7.
  * Priyom — upload final manifest to the shared sheet and send DocuSign crew acknowledgement link.

Links: consolidated schedule sheet https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aNex-SurgeSchedule
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/airnexus-crew-agreement-2027

Thanks everyone — Priyom

Attachments: flight_manifest.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB), consolidated_schedule.pdf (pdf, 220KB)
